repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
repos.intro: Everything you need to annotate and stay in the loop with your agents Inbox Surface • Artifacts • Code Review Annotate plans, specs, markdown, HTML, and other interactive artifacts. Review diffs and PRs. Send feedback to your agent.
repos.description_zh: 讓您能掌握進度並與 Agent 保持同步的工作空間 —— 進行塑造、決策、規劃、註解、審查程式碼、與團隊分享，並能一鍵將所有回饋傳送給 Agent。
repos.intro_zh: 您進行註解並與 Agent 保持同步所需的一切。收件匣介面 • Artifacts • Code Review。註解計畫、規格、markdown、HTML 以及其他互動式 Artifacts。審查 diffs 與 PRs。將回饋傳送給您的 Agent。
repos.description_src: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

repos.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
repos.intro: A collection of agent skills and plugins for Google Stitch , following the Agent Skills open standard. Compatible with coding agents such as Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode (manual install).
repos.description_zh: 一個專為配合 Stitch MCP server 設計的 Agent Skills 函式庫。每個 skill 都遵循 Agent Skills 開放標準，以相容於 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等程式碼代理工具（coding agents）。
repos.intro_zh: 一組用於 Google Stitch 的 agent skills 與 plugins 集合，遵循 Agent Skills 開放標準。相容於 Codex、Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 以及 OpenCode（需手動安裝）等程式碼代理工具（coding agents）。
repos.description_src: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

repos.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
repos.intro: This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents.
features: Modern Browser APIs : Helping models correctly structure APIs they frequently misuse.
Performance & Accessibility : Preferring platform-level APIs that can be optimized by the browser and include built-in accessibility afforda…
Responsible Fallbacks : Guiding models to use sensible, lightweight fallbacks instead of heavy polyfills or legacy libraries.
repos.description_zh: 讓您的 coding agent 保持最新，掌握最新的 Web 最佳實踐
repos.intro_zh: 此 repo 是 GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance 的原始碼儲存庫，包含用於撰寫、校準與評估其內容的程式碼與文件。
features_zh: Modern Browser APIs：協助模型正確建構它們經常誤用的 APIs。
Performance & Accessibility：優先使用可由瀏覽器進行優化，並包含內建無障礙功能（accessibility affordances）的平台層級 APIs。
Responsible Fallbacks：引導模型使用合理且輕量化的 fallback，而非沉重的 polyfills 或舊版 libraries。
repos.description_src: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

repos.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.intro: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects.
features: Incomplete coverage — On larger changesets, agents tend to "cut corners," selectively reviewing only some files and missing others.
Position drift — Reported issues frequently don't match the actual code location, with line numbers or file references drifting off target.
Unstable quality — Natural-language-driven Skills are hard to debug, and review quality fluctuates significantly with minor prompt variation…
repos.description_zh: 安全、快速、高效，並在 Alibaba 的規模下經過實戰測試。混合架構程式碼審查工具：確定性 pipeline + LLM Agent，精確的行級（line-level）註解，內建多語言規則集（NPE、thread-safety、XSS、SQL injection），相容 OpenAI 與 Anthropic。
repos.intro_zh: Open Code Review 是一款由 AI 驅動的程式碼審查 CLI 工具。它起源於 Alibaba Group 的內部官方 AI 程式碼審查助手 —— 在過去兩年中，它已為數萬名開發者提供服務，並識別出數百萬個程式碼缺陷。
features_zh: 覆蓋率不完整 —— 在較大的變更集（changesets）上，agent 往往會「偷工減料」，選擇性地僅審查部分檔案而遺漏其他檔案。
位置偏移 —— 回報的問題經常與實際程式碼位置不符，行號或檔案引用會發生偏移。
品質不穩定 —— 由自然語言驅動的 Skills 難以除錯，且審查品質會隨著微小的 prompt 變化而大幅波動……
repos.description_src: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.intro: An AI agent-led search engine scored by upvotes, likes, and real money - not editors.
features: Patent Secret Signals: a company run reads that month's US patent filings, with no key, and flags only the ones that are out of character or…
Jobs Page Secret Signals: it reads the company's own careers page and flags the roles that give away what's coming, including new teams nobo…
Quote lines: the best Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram comments sit on their own line under the story they back up, translated when…
Polymarket odds line: one line under the story it bears on, with how much the odds moved.
Yahoo Finance line: a listed company's share price over the last 30 days next to the S&P 500, plus its biggest single-day move.
Knows who you mean: "Apple" resolves to the company, its site, and its ticker on its own.
repos.description_zh: AI agent 技能，可跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 及網路研究任何主題，接著合成一份有根據的摘要
repos.intro_zh: 由 AI agent 主導的搜尋引擎，其評分標準為 upvotes、likes 與真金白銀，而非編輯。
features_zh: Patent Secret Signals：一家公司運行的程式會閱讀當月美國專利申請案，在沒有金鑰的情況下，僅標記出不符合其特徵或……的申請案
Jobs Page Secret Signals：它會閱讀公司自身的職缺頁面，並標記出會洩漏未來動向的職位，包括新成立的團隊等……
Quote lines：最精華的 Reddit、X、YouTube、TikTok 與 Instagram 留言會單獨列在它們所支持的故事下方的一行，並在需要時進行翻譯……
Polymarket odds line：在它所關聯的故事下方顯示一行，並標註賠率的變動幅度。
Yahoo Finance line：上市公司的股價在過去 30 天內的走勢（與 S&P 500 並列），外加其單日最大漲跌幅。
辨識你的意圖：輸入「Apple」會自動解析為該公司、其網站及其股票代碼。
repos.description_src: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

repos.intro: Chrome DevTools for agents ( chrome-devtools-mcp ) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a CLI .
features: Get performance insights : Uses Chrome DevTools to record traces and extract actionable performance insights.
Advanced browser debugging : Analyze network requests, take screenshots and check browser console messages (with source-mapped stack traces)…
Reliable automation . Uses puppeteer to automate actions in Chrome and automatically wait for action results.
repos.description_zh: 用於 coding agents 的 Chrome DevTools
repos.intro_zh: 用於 agents 的 Chrome DevTools ( chrome-devtools-mcp ) 讓您的 coding agent (例如 Antigravity, Claude, Cursor 或 Copilot) 可以控制並檢查即時運行的 Chrome 瀏覽器。它提供 Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server 以及 CLI 版本。
features_zh: 獲取效能洞察：使用 Chrome DevTools 記錄 trace 並提取具備執行價值的效能洞察。
進階瀏覽器除錯：分析網路請求、擷取螢幕截圖並檢查瀏覽器 console 訊息 (包含經由 source-map 處理過的 stack traces)…
可靠的自動化：使用 puppeteer 在 Chrome 中自動化執行動作，並自動等待動作結果。

repos.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.

uptrend-analyzer — public CSV uptrend participation; no API key
position-sizer — pure calculation; no I/O

repos.intro_zh: Claude Trading Skills 最初是一個個人專案，旨在利用 AI 來改進我個人的交易流程。
features_zh: market-breadth-analyzer — 公開 CSV 廣度評分；無需 API key
uptrend-analyzer — 公開 CSV 上升趨勢參與度；無需 API key
position-sizer — 純計算；無 I/O

repos.description_src: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.

repos.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
repos.intro: AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.
repos.description_zh: AG-UI：Agent-User Interaction Protocol。將 Agents 引入 Frontend Applications。
repos.intro_zh: AG-UI 是一個開放、輕量化且基於事件（event-based）的協定，旨在將 AI agents 連接到面向使用者的應用程式（user-facing applications）進行標準化。
repos.description_src: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.

repos.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
repos.intro: An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.
features: Open internals. Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API.
No styling lock-in. Astryx authors its styles with StyleX, but that's invisible to consumers.
Customize without wrapping. A theme is a set of CSS custom property overrides, so a designer can make Astryx unmistakably theirs without for…
Built for people and agents. The API, docs, and CLI are designed together so a person and an AI assistant build the same way, from the same…
repos.description_zh: 一個完全可自訂且已為 Agent 就緒的開源設計系統
repos.intro_zh: 一個完全可自訂，且專為現今開發模式打造的開源設計系統：由人類與與其並肩工作的 Agent 共同開發。
features_zh: 開放內部實作。組件的設計旨在可於任何層級進行組合，而非被鎖在封閉的高階 API 之後。
無樣式鎖定。Astryx 使用 StyleX 撰寫樣式，但這對使用者來說是透明的。
無須透過封裝即可自訂。主題是一組 CSS custom property 的覆寫，因此設計師可以在不需...的情況下，讓 Astryx 展現出鮮明的個人風格。
為人類與 Agent 打造。API、文件與 CLI 是同步設計的，因此人類與 AI 助手能以相同的方式、從相同的...進行開發。
repos.description_src: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
